title: Impact of Grade Retention on Future Academic Performance

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
- Method: Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD).
- Why: Grade retention is determined by whether a student’s score falls below a cutoff on the running variable (end-of-year test score). However, compliance is imperfect (treated does not equal 1 for all just-below-cutoff observations in the preview), making the design fuzzy. The discontinuity in the probability of retention at the cutoff serves as an instrument for actual retention.
- Estimand: Local Average Treatment Effect (LATE) of retention for compliers at the cutoff.
- Key assumptions:
  - Continuity: In the absence of treatment, potential future test scores are continuous at the cutoff.
  - No precise manipulation: Students cannot precisely sort around the cutoff.
  - First stage relevance: The probability of retention jumps at the cutoff.
  - Monotonicity: Crossing the cutoff weakly increases the probability of retention for all students (no defiers).

Cutoff: Based on the data (values in [0,1] and a near_cutoff flag around ~0.5), we set the cutoff at 0.5.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Complete, self-contained R code

# 1) Setup ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install/load required packages
pkgs <- c("AER", "sandwich", "lmtest")
for (p in pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(p, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
  library(p, character.only = TRUE)
}

# Try to use rddensity for a manipulation test if available; otherwise skip
if (!requireNamespace("rddensity", quietly = TRUE)) {
  try(install.packages("rddensity", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"), silent = TRUE)
}
has_rddensity <- requireNamespace("rddensity", quietly = TRUE)

# 2) Load data -----------------------------------------------------------------
df <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s97_data.csv")
# Columns assumed:
# - running_var: score in [0,1]
# - treated: indicator of actual retention
# - y: future test scores

# 3) Helper: local fuzzy RD via IV with local-linear/quadratic and triangular weights
fuzzy_rd_iv <- function(data, c = 0.5, h = 0.15, p = 1, donut = 0) {
  # data: data.frame with running_var, treated, y
  # c: cutoff
  # h: bandwidth
  # p: polynomial order (1 or 2)
  # donut: exclude |x| < donut (donut-hole RD)
  x <- data$running_var - c
  keep <- abs(x) <= h & (abs(x) >= donut)
  dat <- data[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(dat) < 20) {
    stop("Too few observations in the chosen window.")
  }
  x <- dat$running_var - c
  L <- as.integer(dat$running_var < c)  # indicator for being below cutoff

  # Construct controls by side with separate slopes
  dat$x <- x
  dat$L <- L
  dat$xL <- dat$x * dat$L
  if (p >= 2) {
    dat$x2 <- dat$x^2
    dat$x2L <- dat$x2 * dat$L
  }

  # Triangular kernel weights
  w <- pmax(0, 1 - abs(dat$x) / h)

  # Build IV formula: y ~ treated + controls | L + controls  (L instruments treated)
  if (p == 1) {
    form_iv <- as.formula("y ~ treated + x + xL | L + x + xL")
  } else {
    form_iv <- as.formula("y ~ treated + x + xL + x2 + x2L | L + x + xL + x2 + x2L")
  }

  fit_iv <- AER::ivreg(form_iv, data = dat, weights = w)

  # Robust SEs
  vc <- sandwich::vcovHC(fit_iv, type = "HC1")
  ct <- lmtest::coeftest(fit_iv, vcov = vc)

  if (!"treated" %in% rownames(ct)) {
    stop("Treated coefficient not found in IV regression.")
  }

  tau <- as.numeric(ct["treated", "Estimate"])
  se  <- as.numeric(ct["treated", "Std. Error"])
  z   <- as.numeric(ct["treated", "t value"])
  pval <- as.numeric(ct["treated", "Pr(>|t|)"])
  ci_low <- tau - 1.96 * se
  ci_high <- tau + 1.96 * se

  # First stage strength (for reference)
  fs_form <- if (p == 1) {
    as.formula("treated ~ L + x + xL")
  } else {
    as.formula("treated ~ L + x + xL + x2 + x2L")
  }
  fs_fit <- stats::lm(fs_form, data = dat, weights = w)
  fs_ct <- lmtest::coeftest(fs_fit, vcov = sandwich::vcovHC(fs_fit, type = "HC1"))
  fs_pi <- if ("L" %in% rownames(fs_ct)) as.numeric(fs_ct["L", "Estimate"]) else NA
  fs_F <- tryCatch({
    # Partial F-stat for instrument L using linearHypothesis
    if (!requireNamespace("car", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("car", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
    library(car)
    lh <- car::linearHypothesis(fs_fit, "L = 0", white.adjust = "hc1")
    as.numeric(lh[2, "F"])
  }, error = function(e) NA)

  list(
    n = nrow(dat),
    h = h,
    p = p,
    donut = donut,
    tau = tau,
    se = se,
    pval = pval,
    ci = c(ci_low, ci_high),
    fs_pi = fs_pi,
    fs_F = fs_F
  )
}

# 4) Baseline estimate ----------------------------------------------------------
cutoff <- 0.5
h_main <- 0.15
ord_main <- 1

res_main <- fuzzy_rd_iv(df, c = cutoff, h = h_main, p = ord_main)

cat("Baseline Fuzzy RD (Local Linear) at cutoff =", cutoff, "bandwidth =", h_main, "\n")
cat("N (window) =", res_main$n, "\n")
cat("LATE (retention on future score) =", round(res_main$tau, 4),
    " [95% CI:", round(res_main$ci[1], 4), ",", round(res_main$ci[2], 4), "]",
    " p-value =", signif(res_main$pval, 3), "\n")
cat("First-stage jump (Pr[retained] at cutoff) =", round(res_main$fs_pi, 4),
    "  Partial F ~", ifelse(is.na(res_main$fs_F), "NA", round(res_main$fs_F, 2)), "\n\n")

# 5) Robustness: Bandwidth sensitivity -----------------------------------------
bandwidths <- c(0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30)
robust_bw <- lapply(bandwidths, function(hh) fuzzy_rd_iv(df, c = cutoff, h = hh, p = 1))
cat("Bandwidth sensitivity (Local Linear):\n")
for (rb in robust_bw) {
  cat(" h =", rb$h,
      " N =", rb$n,
      " tau =", round(rb$tau, 4),
      " p =", signif(rb$pval, 3),
      " 95% CI [", round(rb$ci[1], 4), ",", round(rb$ci[2], 4), "]",
      " FS F ~", ifelse(is.na(rb$fs_F), "NA", round(rb$fs_F, 2)),
      "\n")
}
cat("\n")

# 6) Robustness: Polynomial order (quadratic) -----------------------------------
res_quad <- fuzzy_rd_iv(df, c = cutoff, h = h_main, p = 2)
cat("Polynomial order sensitivity (Quadratic, h =", h_main, "):\n")
cat(" N =", res_quad$n,
    " tau =", round(res_quad$tau, 4),
    " p =", signif(res_quad$pval, 3),
    " 95% CI [", round(res_quad$ci[1], 4), ",", round(res_quad$ci[2], 4), "]",
    " FS F ~", ifelse(is.na(res_quad$fs_F), "NA", round(res_quad$fs_F, 2)),
    "\n\n")

# 7) Robustness: Donut-hole (drop |x| < 0.02) -----------------------------------
res_donut <- fuzzy_rd_iv(df, c = cutoff, h = h_main, p = ord_main, donut = 0.02)
cat("Donut RD (drop |score - cutoff| < 0.02):\n")
cat(" N =", res_donut$n,
    " tau =", round(res_donut$tau, 4),
    " p =", signif(res_donut$pval, 3),
    " 95% CI [", round(res_donut$ci[1], 4), ",", round(res_donut$ci[2], 4), "]\n\n")

# 8) Placebo cutoff test --------------------------------------------------------
placebo_c <- 0.6
res_placebo <- fuzzy_rd_iv(df, c = placebo_c, h = h_main, p = ord_main)
cat("Placebo cutoff at", placebo_c, ":\n")
cat(" N =", res_placebo$n,
    " tau =", round(res_placebo$tau, 4),
    " p =", signif(res_placebo$pval, 3),
    " 95% CI [", round(res_placebo$ci[1], 4), ",", round(res_placebo$ci[2], 4), "]\n\n")

# 9) Reduced-form and first-stage sanity check (Wald) ---------------------------
wald_check <- function(data, c = 0.5, h = 0.15, p = 1) {
  x <- data$running_var - c
  keep <- abs(x) <= h
  dat <- data[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  dat$x <- dat$running_var - c
  dat$L <- as.integer(dat$running_var < c)
  dat$xL <- dat$x * dat$L
  w <- pmax(0, 1 - abs(dat$x) / h)
  if (p == 1) {
    rf_fit <- lm(y ~ L + x + xL, data = dat, weights = w)
    fs_fit <- lm(treated ~ L + x + xL, data = dat, weights = w)
  } else {
    dat$x2 <- dat$x^2; dat$x2L <- dat$x2 * dat$L
    rf_fit <- lm(y ~ L + x + xL + x2 + x2L, data = dat, weights = w)
    fs_fit <- lm(treated ~ L + x + xL + x2 + x2L, data = dat, weights = w)
  }
  rf <- lmtest::coeftest(rf_fit, vcov = sandwich::vcovHC(rf_fit, type = "HC1"))
  fs <- lmtest::coeftest(fs_fit, vcov = sandwich::vcovHC(fs_fit, type = "HC1"))
  rf_jump <- as.numeric(rf["L", "Estimate"])
  fs_jump <- as.numeric(fs["L", "Estimate"])
  list(rf_jump = rf_jump, fs_jump = fs_jump, wald = rf_jump / fs_jump)
}
wald_res <- wald_check(df, c = cutoff, h = h_main, p = ord_main)
cat("Wald check (RF/FS) at cutoff:", cutoff, "bandwidth:", h_main, "\n")
cat(" RF jump =", round(wald_res$rf_jump, 4),
    " FS jump =", round(wald_res$fs_jump, 4),
    " Wald LATE =", round(wald_res$wald, 4), "\n\n")

# 10) McCrary density test (if available) --------------------------------------
if (has_rddensity) {
  x_all <- df$running_var
  den <- rddensity::rddensity(X = x_all, c = cutoff)
  dens_sum <- summary(den)
  cat("McCrary density test at cutoff", cutoff, ":\n")
  cat(" log-difference estimate =", round(dens_sum$Estimate[1], 4),
      " p-value =", signif(dens_sum$`P > |z|`[1], 3), "\n\n")
} else {
  cat("rddensity not available; skipping density manipulation test.\n\n")
}
```

## 3. Expected Findings
- Sign: Retention is expected to negatively affect subsequent test scores at the margin (students near the cutoff), as found in several education studies where grade repetition tends to harm medium-run outcomes for marginal students.
- Magnitude: A local effect around −0.10 to −0.25 standard deviations on future test scores is plausible at the cutoff. The exact estimate will depend on the first-stage strength and bandwidth choice; results should be reasonably stable across nearby bandwidths and polynomial orders, with no significant “effect” at placebo cutoffs and no evidence of manipulation at the cutoff.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: The analysis exploits the cutoff in test scores to identify the causal effect.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Students retained due to scoring below the cutoff perform worse on future tests.
